question: Across all supported sports and all available periods, does allowing model-selected underdogs reduce losses relative to skipping them and market choices?
scope: Local four-sport retrospective study, no production, wallet, database, deployment or automatic adoption changes.
corpora: Union of complete local settled primary-price cache (45184 events, Jan2023-Aug2026) and broad raw Proto archive (171565 market rows, 2023-2026), with conflicting physical fixtures excluded rather than cheapest/best price selection
Separate long-run external football Matches.csv (238858 source rows); never sum foreign/domestic fixture counts or profits as independent observations
markets: Primary full-game win/draw/loss only. Inventory all other families and exclusion counts; handicap/total/half/parity are not primary outcome forecasts and will not be mislabeled validated.
period: Every valid source date, earliest to latest. Cold-start fallback to market until 200 earlier fixtures per sport. Monthly refits, labels eligible only day+4 <= month start; targets/features use pending labels only day+4 <= target day. No first-year trained-on-future backfill.
fixed_models: outcome_form: fixed ridge0.01 multinomial logit over causal Elo difference (sport K bs12/sc24/bk16/vl18, home advantage45, scale400), last20 result gap and league prior home/draw rates with Laplace smoothing
market_residual: identical fixed features/ridge, log(market) offset
half_market_form: fixed50:50 market/outcome_form sensitivity, not tuned or selected by outcomes
feature_note: All new outcome-only features rebuilt from raw normalized fixture labels under +4calendar-day hypothetical availability. No postgame scores/shots/CSV Elo features, no preserved full-dataset feature scalers. This extends research comparison to four sports, NOT the same Poisson score-static model and NOT a tipster9:1 ablation. Exact earlier score-static evidence retained separately by source reference, not pooled.
workers: Terra football/baseball/basketball/volleyball bounded workers execute identical shared frozen harness, each in isolated worktree. Parent handles common input/rules/verification/conclusion; external archive connection separate bounded worker.
definitions: Underdog if selected market p below maximum, maximum ties separate. Soccer underdog rank2/rank3/draw separate. One flat unit per selected event; net odds-1 or -1; exclude unknown/void labels with reason. No odds cutoff/EV search/2-leg/actual wallet cap modifications.
metrics: Every sport, league, year, month and pooled-within-cohort: opportunities,bets,hits,flat-unit net,turnover ROI,net/opportunity,monthly gains/losses,daily-close drawdown; same-event score-market and underdog-versus-skip week-cluster descriptive bootstrap2000; first/second chronological halves; report sign reversals and sparse leagues; no after-the-fact winner selection.
adoption_decision: A universal include-underdogs recommendation requires positive incremental underdog net across sports/time sensitivities, uncertainty not dominated by a few outcomes, and executable pregame evidence. Otherwise explicitly reject blanket inclusion and preserve conditional candidate only. Historical winners are not optimal future choices.
verification: Immutable source hashes; unique fixtures/conflict removal; independent Decimal payout/aggregation; current and future label flips do not change frozen monthly model or earlier forecasts, input permutation invariance, same-day embargo, 3-way draw and rank/market-tie/empty/fallback cases; full pytest.
limitations: All sources previously inspected, settled archive selection, price timestamp/execution certification absent; source cutoff not today. Date+4 is assumed information availability, not witnessed receipt. No fabricated tipster inputs for missing sports. Four supported sports do not imply all world sports or all market families.
